svg.title: Magnetoelastic Magnon-Phonon Avoided Crossing and Four-Lane HPC Solver Architecture
svg.desc: Two-panel scientific figure showing (a) the exact analytically computed magnon-phonon avoided crossing dispersion omega_pm(k) hybridizing the bare spin-wave branch omega_m(k) = omega_0 + D_ex k^2 and transverse acoustic phonon omega_ph(k) = c_t k with polaron gap Delta omega_me plus coupled congruence-scaled eigenpencil and YIG G5 oracles, and (b) the bidirectional spin-elastic time-stepping loop (explicit leapfrog/RK4 vs IMEX-ARK2/Generalized-alpha) mapped across all four FDM/FEM CPU/GPU HPC solver lanes.
svg.text: Exact hybridized branches ω±(k) & magnetoelastic polaron gap Δωme
